# Why Can More Advanced Tools Leave People More Exhausted?

Tools can raise efficiency while also increasing information density, operating frequency, and maintenance load. When complexity grows faster than human capacity for carrying and recovery, more advanced tools can coexist with deeper fatigue.

## What the question is really asking

This article is not a verdict about a particular person, organization, or event. It examines the relationship behind the question at a general systems level. Separating mechanism from outcome makes it possible to see why a similar relationship can appear differently under different conditions.

When conditions change, the path, intensity, and result can also change. A mechanism therefore describes a formation process rather than a fixed destiny.

General mechanism and case-specific judgment must remain distinct. A concrete case still depends on its own facts, position, constraints, and evidence.
